zone = vals['e0dd5f44-f050-5faa-a2a0-a3fcb6284ae8']  # Z3Z01 zone sensor
rooms = ['7b341b6e-9e39-5f4f-93ec-f75b5df46a68','e52af9c7-e939-5f5f-9c0f-c10c64981883',

content.text: The available time series are only zone air temperature sensors, zone heating/cooling setpoints, and VAV damper setpoints. For Core_mid (Zone_F3_Z01) the temperature rose ~0.6 °C after July 2018, but so did essentially every other zone (≈ +0.4 to +0.63 °C), and the reading still follows a normal seasonal pattern with normal variance. With no independent, cross-referencing measurement, no occupancy/plugin-load/CO₂ stream for the Core_mid rooms, and no VAV supply-air temperature to back out delivered energy, the data cannot tell a real local load increase apart from a slow sensor calibration/drift.
